name: gerror
description: Native by behavior. Standard by semantics. Portable by representation. Serializable by design.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:biome && npm run lint:ts
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit:deno: env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CI="${CI:-}" deno test --no-check --allow-read=. src/
scripts.coverage:deno: rm -rf coverage/deno && env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CI="${CI:-}" deno test --no-check --allow-read=. --coverage=coverage/deno/raw src/ && deno coverage coverage/deno/raw --lcov --output=coverage/deno/lcov.info

author: Huan LI <zixia@zixia.net>
